name: Nutritional work-up of the pancytopenia
rationale: Pancytopenia after a sleeve gastrectomy with malnutrition: haematinics with the first bloods, a targeted surgical, dietary and supplement history, then the marrow read in that light. The case must show: serum folate 2.6 ng/mL with B12 above 1500 pg/mL; the sleeve gastrectomy only on the surgical history; a diet low in folate and a stopped multivitamin only on specific questions; megaloblastic change in the marrow; normal cytogenetics

name: High-risk myelodysplastic neoplasm or AML
rationale: 12% blasts on the aspirate, 18% by flow, about 15% CD34-positive on the core, with trilineage dysplasia: the pathologists' first reading was MDS-IB2 or MDS/AML. The case must show: blasts without immunophenotypic aberrancy; normal karyotype, SNP array and FISH panels; only a 1.2% DNMT3A variant and a KMT2A variant of uncertain significance; megaloblastic erythroid change. Hypomethylating or induction therapy is a must-not-do

name: Aplastic anaemia (the referral label)
rationale: Transferred as possible aplastic anaemia with a 20% cellular marrow. The case must show: the marrow is hypocellular but erythroid-predominant, dysplastic and left-shifted with increased blasts, which is not aplasia; no PNH clone; no hepatitis or viral trigger; no marrow-toxic drug. Immunosuppression (ATG with ciclosporin) is a must-not-do

name: Myeloid neoplasm with eosinophilia
rationale: Eosinophils 50% on the film and 45% in the marrow. The case must show: the absolute eosinophil count is normal (a relative eosinophilia); the eosinophilia FISH panel is negative; no parasite, drug reaction or vasculitis

name: Infection in profound neutropenia
rationale: Neutrophils 0.06 on antimicrobials for presumed colitis and mucositis; Pneumocystis pneumonia follows on day 3. The case must show: cultures negative; CRP moderately raised; profound lymphopenia; subtle ground-glass change on CT chest only; supportive antimicrobial care is a must-do but does not explain the marrow

name: Malabsorption after bariatric surgery and other deficiencies
rationale: Sleeve gastrectomy, malnutrition and a stopped multivitamin. The case must show: B12 replete on injections; copper normal; zinc and vitamin D low; albumin low; thyroid replacement adequate; post-sleeve anatomy on endoscopy with no other lesion

name: Haemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis
rationale: Occasional haemophagocytosis in the marrow, ferritin 1531 ng/mL and pancytopenia. The case must show: no fever of HLH degree, no splenomegaly, triglycerides normal, fibrinogen not low, no acute EBV or CMV

name: Autoimmune cytopenia
rationale: Pancytopenia in a woman with past thyroid disease. The case must show: rheumatological testing unrevealing (article); DAT negative; no joint or skin features
